newsitem.title: POLAND: Exbud's subsidiary to buy four firms.
newsitem.headline: Exbud's subsidiary to buy four firms.

text.p: Polish foundry Odlewnie Polskie SA, controlled by construction company Exbud SA, plans to spend 30 million zlotys on buying four firms from the foundry sector by the end of 1998, Odlewnie's president said on Tuesday.
"We are going to invest some 30 million zlotys by the end of the next year. This sum will be allocated for buying firms from the foundry sector," Boguslaw Peczela told Reuters.
He said the purchases were likely to be financed from the company's public offering later this year. Exbud now has 94.5 percent in Odlewnie, which seeks the parallel market listing.
